home.featuresSubtitle: End-to-end automated pipeline integrating multilingual OCR, cadastral shape verification, and revenue officer validation.

about.title: Modernizing Historical Land Records with Cadastral AI
about.description: ILRDVS is designed to bridge historical paper records (Modi script, archaic Marathi, and revenue formats) with modern digital land registries, ensuring every land parcel is securely geo-referenced and tamper-proof.
about.mission: Our Mission: 100% digital transparency, zero boundary disputes, and instant citizen access to certified 7/12 extracts.
about.vision: A unified cadastral spatial registry powering citizen empowerment and ease of governance.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find immediate answers regarding 7/12 extracts, mutation applications, and AI verification.
faq.q1: How does the AI OCR digitization work?
faq.a1: Our vision models process scanned Marathi and English land records to transcribe survey numbers, khata details, and boundaries for citizen review and Talathi approval.
faq.q2: What should I do if a discrepancy is detected?
faq.a2: You will receive an alert on your Citizen Portal. Simply review the flagged variance and submit your clarification or supporting tax receipt directly to the officer.
faq.a3: Yes. Approved records carry digital government signatures and QR codes compliant with the Information Technology Act.

dashboard.aiTransparencyTitle: How ILRDVS AI Works for You
dashboard.aiTransparencyDesc: When you upload a Marathi/English land document, our vision model automatically transcribes survey numbers, khata details, and owner names. You review every extracted field before official Talathi verification.

upload.wizardSubtitle: Submit Land Record for Cadastral AI Extraction
upload.wizardDesc: Upload your official land document. Our AI will transcribe the records, which you can verify before submission.
upload.selectCategorySubtitle: Choose the exact document type you are uploading. This helps our OCR model apply the correct revenue template.
upload.dragDropTitle: Drag & drop your document file here
upload.dragDropSubtitle: Scanned 7/12 extract or official revenue certificate in high resolution (300 DPI recommended).
upload.demoSampleDesc: Don't have a file handy? Use our preloaded sample 7/12 Extract (Survey 142/3, Pune).
upload.aiProgressSubtitle: Please wait while our vision model transcribes Marathi and English land record details. Information will be presented for your review.
upload.aiRealisticStandard: Realistic verification standard • Does not make automated ownership declarations
upload.reviewBannerTitle: AI Extraction Complete. Please Review Carefully.
upload.reviewBannerDesc: Compare the extracted data against your original document. You can click on any field to edit spelling or numbers before final submission.
upload.authSubtitle: To prevent fraudulent land record submissions, verify your identity with an OTP sent to your linked mobile number.
upload.finalReviewSubtitle: Please review all submitted details before final submission to the Taluka Land Records Office.
upload.legalUndertakingText: I hereby declare that the uploaded document and provided information are true, authentic, and accurate to the best of my knowledge. I understand that submitting fraudulent or tampered land records is a punishable offence under the Maharashtra Land Revenue Code and Indian Penal Code.
upload.successTitle: Thank You! Your Land Record is Submitted
upload.successDesc: Your application has been assigned an official reference number and entered into the cadastral verification queue.
upload.smsConfirmation: An SMS confirmation has been dispatched to your mobile number.
